description: Marks one item on a business menu as sold out for today, or puts it back on. Needs a personal connector token, `business`, `soldOut`, and `itemId` or `itemName`. Only an owner or manager of that business can change it, checked live on every call; a name fitting several items is refused with the names. It works in two steps: a call without `confirm` returns a preview and a `confirmToken` and changes nothing; a call with confirm true and that token makes the change.

business.description: The business by name or id, as biz_menu returned it.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which changes nothing; true with confirmToken makes the change.

confirmToken.description: The token the first call returned.

requestId.description: Optional caller id, 8 or more characters; a repeat returns the first result.

soldOut.description: true marks it sold out today; false puts it back.

name: biz_set_item_availability
title: Set menu item availability
